notes.title: Nightmare Mode Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I am excited to announce a brand new Gamemode called Nightmare Mode!

In this mode, you will need to escape the nightmare by activating 3 generators and finding 3 keys, but watch out for the enemy chasing you. This Gamemode is not a hard difficulty for the main story mode. It is a completely separate mode with a brand new map.

Have fun trying to complete it!
